items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: Carson and I got like really close... we had this inside thing... I was one of the very few acts to work that show... symbiotic relationship

ctx.x: Yeah. When you were — knew that you were recording for an LP did you change anything in your routine because the physical visual part of it wasn’t going to be there?

Yeah. No I just did it. You know my theory was always different, in fact I had a long talk with Johnny Carson rest his soul, one night I was talking to him and he said, he says, “You get it, you do the right thing.” I said, “What do you mean?” He said, he says, “You do what I’ve always done” he says, “I don’t do anything I do for the television audience. I do it for the audience there, the 500 people.” And that’s what I always did. I worked to the 500 people there and let the director, let him translate that to…
Did you fall afoul of Johnny Carson for a number of years?
